acceptance: The dashboard keeps 924 as the denominator, reports listed, implemented, independently validated and production-proven tiers cumulatively, and counts source apps and (app, operation) pairs from witness-bound fixtures only.

positive.fixture: 2 of 924 implemented, 0 validated, 0 proven; 3 source apps, 3 operation pairs; committed file equals fresh output

negative.fixture: extra unbound fixtures or apps never move a tier; a higher claim moves only its own tier

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: Build is one pass over entries and fixtures.
known_limitations: Source-operation counts come from synthetic fixtures; they say nothing about real applications
